title: Job: retention cleanup for Postgres and object storage

user_story.i_want: expired data removed from Postgres and object storage

description: The `retention-cleanup` job runs daily at 01:00. It drops telemetry partitions that are entirely older than retention (default 30 days), deletes raw/staged objects older than raw_retention_days (default 7) by listing date prefixes and calling DeleteObjects (≤1000 keys per call), and deletes ledger rows older than 30 days. It has a dry-run mode. Per-source retention from the catalog is out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.then: it logs what would be deleted and deletes nothing
only partitions entirely older than the cutoff are dropped
they are deleted in 3 DeleteObjects calls
